findings.entity: skater and skateboard during first flip trick
findings.description: After a single ordinary tail pop at ~01:25, rider and board remain airborne until ~03:00-03:25 (~1.7 s). Between ~01:90 and ~02:60 the board holds an almost fixed underside-to-camera orientation and position while the rider hangs at constant height with no ballistic rise/fall, then the descent resumes. The hang time and stalled mid-air motion are far beyond what a flat-ground pop can produce, while surrounding walking/rolling motion runs at normal speed.

findings.entity: skater and skateboard during second trick
findings.description: Pop at ~07:75-08:00 yields roughly 1.3 s of airtime (landing ~09:25); from ~08:25 to ~08:75 rider stays tucked at near-constant height above a near-flat board without the expected parabolic descent, an airtime disproportionate to a flat-ground ollie-type pop.
